title: Brand family / Sub-brands
slide_intent: Provide a default architecture because every initiative does not need an independently invented identity.
strategic_value: A generic lockup can let Duolingo’s smaller services remain connected to the master brand.
demonstration: A sub-brand specimen accompanies an explanation that uniquely branded products have their own rules while other initiatives use a generic layout.
practical_value: Use the generic structure only after checking whether the product has its own guidance.

content_islands.name: Generic specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the supplied sub-brand arrangement and display controls in the left area.

content_islands.name: Scope distinction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and distinction between uniquely governed products and other initiatives in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says the generic layout helps keep the family consistent.
reference_purposes.Application: The generic layout is assigned to sub-brands and initiatives without their own rules.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source distinguishes products with specific branding rules from those using the generic layout.

ingredient.name: Generic sub-brand lockup
ingredient.role: Keep initiatives attached to the master identity.
ingredient.application: Use the generic layout for initiatives that lack dedicated branding rules.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical default architecture; uniquely branded offerings such as the source’s Plus example have separate guidance.
